name: Archer
fantasy: The warden of high ground. Climbs, reads the field, pins people to walls.
silhouette: the long weapon over the shoulder

passive.name: Focus
passive.desc: Builds while you stand still (full in 1.4s), sneak (2.8s), 50% faster on high ground. Drains while running and drops 40 when hit. At 100 your next shot is fully drawn or aimed at once, with +20% range.

dash.name: Grapple Arrow
dash.desc: A line arrow at the cursor (9m). If it bites a wall, rock or ledge you zip to it and climb on top; if it bites nothing you hop 3.2m back. Works from a glide and cools it.

variants.tap: A snare arrow 11m: 8 damage and root 0.6 on a foe; on the ground it plants a Tripwire (root 1.2, reveal 3s).
variants.hold: Pinning Shot: 14m, 16 damage, push 6, pierces 1; pushed into a wall within 3m roots 1.2.
variants.air: Plunge: shoot straight down, push 8 around you, lift yourself 3m, cool the glider.
variants.during_e: Inside your Flare zone snares seek revealed targets.

e.name: Flare Arrow
e.desc: Lob a flare up to 14m: it reveals everyone within 7m for 4s, and the zone keeps revealing anyone who walks in. Shows traps, stealth and smoke.

r.name: Skyfall Volley
r.desc: Aim a 5m circle up to 16m: 0.8s of arrows arcing up, then 5 waves 0.4s apart (6 damage, slow). The last roots 1.0 in the inner 2m.

tells.full: a bright glint and a thin aim line
tells.dash_spent: the rope line, dash pip dark
